conj:cube-refined-initial-segment-law.assessment: Conjecture in the remaining n>=7 small-prime range outside proved subranges. Proved in characteristic zero for all n,d; in every characteristic not two for n<=6 and d>=2; for p>2^(n-1)d; and in the recorded periodic bands. At n7,d>=5: all p>19; p17 except d=14mod17; p19 except d=13mod19; p7,d=5mod7; p3,d=1,4,5mod9; and every exact integer conic pivot-unit class. Several full rational boundaries have proved infinite-family defects, which do not refute original generic normality. Degrees2-4 in dimension7 and the remaining higher-dimensional small-prime ranges remain separate. Degree-one orders retain the Catalan law. Generic normality does not determine pre-stable thresholds.

conj:cube-refined-initial-segment-law.mathematical_status: Current dimension-seven ranges are consolidated in the assessment from the reviewed survivor proofs; the full conjecture remains open.
